intro.text: Artifabrians are the engineers of Roshar who design and build fabrials.
Artifabrians are the engineers of Roshar who design and build fabrials. In Vorin lands it is considered women's work.

description.text: Artifabrians have tried for centuries to recreate Shardplate. Their nearest success so far is half-shards, which work on a different design.
They sort fabrials into groups they call Altering, Pairing and Warning fabrials, and Altering and Pairing fabrials draw much of their research and theorising. They also install new fabrials.
Their methods, including how spren are captured in gems, are closely guarded secrets, and Thaylen artifabrians have a secret way to fine-tune the Stormlight inside a fabrial.

items.text: Longshadow designed a type of painrial.
Navani Kholin helped create many fabrials, including the Grandbow, and helped refine Longshadow's painrial.
Rushu, an ardent in Navani's service, worked on new kinds of fabrial and helped make several discoveries about using aluminum with them.
Tomor, another ardent working for Navani, invented a fabrial worn on the wrist that can lift its wearer in one direction for a short time.
Ulvlk, a Thaylen scholar, revealed to Navani the secret of moving Stormlight between gemstones.
